quest.title: With You
quest.description: Now knowing that all this came from her mother's childhood wish, Kamisato Ayaka invites you to go with her to Amakane Island to take part in a festivity that she has been looking forward to for a long time now.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x500, Primogem x60, Mora x34075, Guide to Elegance x5, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

chapter.title: The Whispers of the Crane and the White Rabbit

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're here! But it doesn't seem as lively as Paimon imagined... What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Since it's the final day, many of the visitors must have already returned home.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I've heard that the peddlers often close up shop earlier on the last day because there are fewer people around.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are we too late?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'll go and ask. Whatever happens, I at least need to go inside, just this once. Hm!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's the way to go! We'll be right there with you.

talks.objective: Go to the festival with Kamisato Ayaka

dialogues.speaker: Shimizu
dialogues.text: May your futures be filled with good fortune!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: It hasn't closed yet, it's just that there aren't many people left... Let's hurry and see as much as we can!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, look at that stall! They have so many masks!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's heard that everyone's supposed to wear a mask at these kinds of festivals. Is that rule still around nowadays, or...?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: That used to be the custom, yes, and today, it's still a popular way to dress up during festivals. But it's not a hard-and-fast rule.

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: Hey! Is that who I think it is? Miss Kamisato, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Oh! Uh... Ahem. Greetings.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: People seem to recognize Ayaka wherever we go! Guess that's just what it's like when you're a famous Inazuman...

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: Hahaha, but of course! The Kamisato Clan leads the Yashiro Commission. It's one of the most well-known clans in Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: Not least because back when Master and Miss Kamisato had just taken over the family's affairs, they used to make public appearances all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: Some of the younger generations have never even seen Miss Kamisato in person before. Being the age I am — I'm lucky enough to have seen her on many occasions over the years.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: You're too kind. My brother and I simply go where we must to fulfill our duties.

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: Haha, but this is the first time I've seen anyone from your family at a festival. There must be some official business, I take it?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Oh, there isn't, actually. Today, I'm taking my traveler friend here around to see the sights.

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: Oh? A traveler? Huh, now that you mention it... You do look like you've come a long way to get here!

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: First time in Inazuma? Hope you enjoy yourself, young one.

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: Ah— excuse me one second.

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: Hey, everyone! Listen up! Don't close up yet! Miss Kamisato has come to join the festival!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: N—No, it's not like that!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Please, there's no need to make a fuss, we're just here to—

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, thanks a lot mister! If you hadn't let them know, they'd start closing down about now, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: At least, it sure looks like that time of day.

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: Haha, yep, you got it! But on account of this being the first time Miss Kamisato has ever come to the festival, it seems only fair to keep things open a little longer!

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: Oh — here's a couple of masks for you. On the house.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: No no no no no, you've been far too accommodating to us already, we couldn't possibly—

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: Ah, don't gimme all that! Here you go!

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: Here you go. It's not often that we regular folks get some attention from the Yashiro Commission, so I've gotta mark the occasion somehow! Besides, it'll make me look bad if you refuse, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: But...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: ...Okay, I... think I understand.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you for your generosity, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: Hahaha, it's my pleasure! You have yourself a good time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sir, do you have anything for Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: Ooh, hello there kiddo, um... I'm sorry, but we don't have any masks in your size.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? ...Surely you're not gonna let Paimon be the only one at the festival without a mask?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: *chuckle* Paimon, don't worry, wearing a mask is optional...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But, but... Paimon doesn't wanna feel left out!

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: How about... a tree leaf? That should be enough to cover up that little face of yours.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!? No way!

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: Ooh, okay then... Hmm, in that case, I'm afraid there's nothing I can do right now... But don't you worry, kiddo, I'll have a mini mask made specially for you when I get back.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I cannot thank you enough.

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: Ah, it's nothing! But I won't hold you up any longer — you should go and enjoy the festival while everything's still lit up.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Alright! Traveler, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Oh, wait! Um... Just one thing...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I need to explain myself. I got a little nervous back there and... I—I just made up any old excuse. But don't think of this as me taking you sight-seeing, please!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I brought you here because... because I genuinely wanted to spend time with you.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: ...Okay, great!

choices.text: Don't worry, Ayaka, no misunderstanding here.

dialogues.speaker: Murakami
dialogues.text: Good food is good for the soul, and sharing it around is the wholesome thing to do!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a great sign. Good things lie ahead!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Congratulations.

dialogues.speaker: Shimizu
dialogues.text: You all have very fine fortunes lined up. With this kind of luck, you'll certainly be able to achieve anything that you wish.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well said! Here's hoping that our good luck will never run out.

dialogues.speaker: Yoshikawa
dialogues.text: There's power in these Prayer Plaques, you know. Have faith, your wishes will surely be fulfilled.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: This food stall sells all kinds of Inazuman specialties. Anything you want to eat, it's my treat!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, it all looks so good... Is it okay if Paimon has one of everything? *chuckle*

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Hahaha, of course it is.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, but we don't want anything to go to waste. Let's try them one at a time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ayaka, Paimon wants those Dango!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Sure!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll have one of those pink pancake things.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh-huh, those look good too! Ooooh, but so do the Egg Rolls... Paimon will try an Egg Roll too, please!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Alright then. I too shall have a Sakura Mochi.

dialogues.speaker: Murakami
dialogues.text: Alright, coming right up!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Mmm! This Sakura Mochi is just delicious!

dialogues.speaker: Murakami
dialogues.text: Not bad, huh? It's one of our best-sellers.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Please, sir, Paimon would like some more!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I don't know if it's rude of me to ask, but how is this kind of snack actually made?

dialogues.speaker: Murakami
dialogues.text: Haha, you wanna try your hand at making it yourself? No problem, just give me a second and I'll write out the recipe for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A new recipe!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: A—Are you sure about this? If you share the recipe... isn't that tantamount to giving away your trade secrets... or something?

dialogues.speaker: Murakami
dialogues.text: Well, it was you who gave Kiminami Restaurant that recipe for an overseas dish, wasn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Murakami
dialogues.text: Hehe, she and I are good friends. We trade culinary tips all the time.

dialogues.speaker: Murakami
dialogues.text: Here you go, just treat it as me returning a favor on behalf of my friend.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: ...Thank you so much, I will study it very carefully and try my best to do it justice.

dialogues.speaker: Murakami
dialogues.text: You there, you want the recipe too? Go on, I can see that you enjoyed it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks, boss!

dialogues.speaker: Murakami
dialogues.text: There's no greater feeling than creating delicious food with your own two hands. You should definitely give it a try.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I will!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Once I've learned how to make it... will you two be my taste testers?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, definitely! Can't wait!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looking forward to it already.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Alright... I'll do my best!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Mine says "Great Fortune From Heaven."

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Wow... You're so lucky!

dialogues.speaker: Shimizu
dialogues.text: Congratulations are in order! Here's what Great Fortune From Heaven means: "The blessings of the gods are upon you. Your voyage ahead shall be plain sailing, and all your endeavors shall prosper." In other words, your good luck isn't about to run out anytime soon!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: This stall sells Prayer Plaques. It's an Inazuman tradition — you draw your wish onto a pentagonal piece of wood called a Prayer Plaque and pray that it will come true.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds similar to the way people in Liyue release lanterns during Lantern Rite. Those are used for making wishes, too.

dialogues.speaker: Yoshikawa
dialogues.text: Oh, welcome! Looking for Prayer Plaques? Every wish is sacred, and you've still got time to make yours before the festival ends!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks fun! Shall we give it a try?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Wait, there's writing and drawing involved? Count Paimon out, then... Paimon's head's feeling kinda fuzzy after eating so much just now... not the best time for an intense burst of mental activity...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Two Prayer Plaques please, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Yoshikawa
dialogues.text: Two Prayer Plaques for the young lady. There you go!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Traveler, have you decided on your wish?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yep! How about you?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Yoshikawa
dialogues.text: You can either draw a picture to represent your wish or write it out in words. Either way, once you've committed your wish onto your plaque, please hang it onto the Prayer Rack.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, so they'll be on public display!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Alright, {NICKNAME}, well, let's see what you got!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: That will do for mine.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: May I see yours?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You got it!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: #This is you and your {F#brother}{M#sister}, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: It's lovely.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #Yes. I want {F#him}{M#her} back.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You'll be back together one day. Paimon believes it, and you should too!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I believe it too. Your wish will surely come true.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: And... I will keep you in my prayers.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ayaka, what did you draw? Is that Tenshukaku?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: That's right. I wish for peace and happiness for everyone in Inazuma, and good health for my family and friends.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: *sigh* I do hope that wish can come true.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It will.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Thank you, that gives me hope.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: *sigh* I think that might be all we have time for today.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw... It's time to leave already?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I'm afraid so. The festival is coming to a close.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Time flies when you're having fun... It seems to flow away from you like a rushing river... As precious and short-lived as a cherry blossom dancing in the wind...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: It's time to leave.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Traveler... Today was the first time in my life that I've ever been to a festival.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: You've known me for some time now... I think you understand my personality, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Knowing me... I just know that today could not have been such a happy day without you.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: So, thank you. Today really meant a lot to me, and the memories will always have a special place in my heart.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Festivals are great! There aren't many rules, everyone has that smile that comes from deep inside, and... it's just so carefree and happy...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: If I ever get the chance... Hee-hee, I wanna go again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to go again, too.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: You too? Great!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: You know, we're kind of similar, with both of us having a brother.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: #Sometimes, I feel like I can relate to the determination you must have... to get your {F#brother}{M#sister} back.

choices.text: #Yes, {F#he}{M#she} means an awful lot to me.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: I understand.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Family bonds are inseparable — no one can break them... They are the most important roots we have in this world.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: #You will find {F#him}{M#her}. Come what may, you must never give up.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: I will always be here for you as your... Ahem! As your friend. I will always support you.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: As long as you're happy, I'm happy.

choices.text: Today made me very happy, too.
Thanks for being a splendid host today.
#Finding {F#him}{M#her} is the whole reason for my journey.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: What do you think of my dance? Did you... like it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It was so pretty!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Beautiful, elegant, and... and something else Paimon can't put into words. *thinking* Paimon doesn't really know what it was, but, it is art.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was delightful.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Phew... I'm not very good at this kind of dance. So as long as I didn't embarrass myself, that's all that matters.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: I just... had a sudden urge, and I ran with it...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Hahaha... In a way, that sort of sums up today for me. Dancing like nobody's watching.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: That goes for you too.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: When I'm with you... time seems to slow down and speed up at the same time.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Anyway, it looks like this is goodbye for today.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: I can see myself the rest of the way back.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Goodnight, Ayaka.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Goodnight, Traveler.

choices.text: You're a pleasure to be around!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Traveler, look, this stall's doing fortune slips.

dialogues.speaker: Shimizu
dialogues.text: Miss Kamisato, hello there! You're out with friends today? What a rare privilege — welcome, welcome! Would you like to give it a go?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Okay! How much is it per draw?

dialogues.speaker: Shimizu
dialogues.text: Hehehe, I wouldn't expect you to know this, but the Yashiro Commission was very good to my uncle on my father's side at one point in time. Thinking about it, it was when your father was around, I think he dealt with it personally.

dialogues.speaker: Shimizu
dialogues.text: So you see? How could I possibly take your money?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: What? A—Are you sure?

dialogues.speaker: Shimizu
dialogues.text: Of course! If you like what you see, then please, be my guest. Same goes for your two friends here.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Traveler, Paimon... What do you think?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It seems like everyone wants to do something nice for Ayaka! So if they insist... who are we to resist!

choices.text: If they're offering, who are we to refuse?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
response.text: Well, if that's how you feel, then... okay! We'll take you up on your kind offer, sir! Let's each do a draw.

response.speaker: Shimizu
response.text: Alrighty then! Whenever you're ready.

response.speaker: Shimizu
response.text: Draw a slip and reveal your fortune!

choices.text: I'm enjoying being a VIP by association!

dialogues.speaker: Sanden
dialogues.text: Have fun!

dialogues.speaker: Shimizu
dialogues.text: Open it up and see how you fare!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Whoa!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Which one did you get? Paimon got "Rising Fortune."

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: No way, we got the same one!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Traveler, what did you get?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we may have arrived near the end of the festival, but it's still been super fun. Paimon approves!

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Yes, I agree.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: To spend the festival together with you today has been a truly wonderful experience.
